The delta, prior record, PR intent/threads, and head SHA were all unreadable.

No reviewers were spawned: without git/gh the incremental delta since 69e5727 could not be determined, so no grounded review was possible, and subagents run Bash in the same broken sandbox. prior_importants is empty because the prior record could not be read, not because none existed. THIS ROUND DID NOT REVIEW THE PR; it must not be read as a clean review. Re-run after the runner sandbox is fixed.
